messages:
maria: Starting thread for migration `mig_2026_04_userflags_tiered` in the 03:00-04:30 PST change window. Adds nullable `user_flags` jsonb and a targeted backfill across tenant tiers. Primary plan: 2-phase backfill (streaming COPY for high-volume tenants, small-batch updates for the rest) with adaptive pacing. Will require a canary holdpoint at 03:15.

deploybot: migration queued: mig_2026_04_userflags_tiered (id: mig-202604). Canary holdpoint set at 03:15. Use `/deploy abort 1711359999` to stop. Run params can be modified with `/deploy update 1711359999 --param=value`.

alex: Proposed conservative defaults after last week's tail spike: batch_size=4000, sleep_ms=120, jitter=12%, concurrency=3. Also enable `replica_shed=true` so leaders detect replica lag and throttle.

ken: For replica_shed we'll expose a quick toggle for oncall: `POST /ops/replica-toggle {"mode":"shed"}`. That lets us temporarily relieve primary pressure if apply lag climbs. I'll wire the endpoint and short-lived token by EOD.

maria: Runbook SQL and copy hints (add to the incident bundle):

```sql
-- Add column
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN user_flags jsonb NULL;

-- small-batch update template
UPDATE users u
SET user_flags = '{"flags": []}'
FROM (
  SELECT id FROM users WHERE user_flags IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 4000
) s
WHERE u.id = s.id;

-- streaming copy for big tenants (psql):
\copy (SELECT id, '{"flags":[]}' FROM users WHERE tenant_id=123 AND user_flags IS NULL) TO '/tmp/tenant123_copy.csv'
-- then on target: \copy users(id,user_flags) FROM '/tmp/tenant123_copy.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv)
```

Add note: prefer COPY during low-replication windows and only for tenants with >5M rows.

jamie: I'll set deploybot params now: `batch_size=4000`, `jitter_pct=12`, `concurrency=3`, `replica_shed=enabled`, `sleep_ms=120`, start 03:00, canary 03:15. Also will pin canary service fleet to `v2.3.2-canary` so older instances don't attempt to read new column prematurely.

deploybot: config applied for 1711359999: batch_size=4000, jitter_pct=12, concurrency=3, replica_shed=enabled, sleep_ms=120. Scheduled start: 03:00. Canary at 03:15.

linda: Reminder: frontend teams must keep feature flag off until we flip. Also pin migration check in the rollout: `app-schema-check == v2.3.2-canary` on canary hosts.

alex: Rollback triggers (agreed):
- p95 API latency increase > 10% sustained for 10 minutes
- error rate delta +3% absolute over baseline for 5m
- replication lag > 45s for > 5m
- DB deadlocks >= 5 in 10m
If any condition met -> run `/deploy abort 1711359999` and escalate to DB oncall. Post-abort steps: stop backfill, snapshot current progress, and run revert plan (drop column if safe, or mark backfill state in metadata table). Owner: alex for revert script.

maria: I'll own metrics snapshot and quick-compare dashboard. Adding a soft-commit verification before increasing concurrency: sample 2000 rows on canary shard and validate `user_flags` presence + schema. If pass, ramp to full concurrency.

ken: Also recommend a short read-only probe for downstream services during canary: `GET /health?expect_user_flags=false` — that'll catch any code paths expecting column existence. Ops to run oncall smoke script at 03:10.

jamie: I've added a small verification tool to release artifacts: `scripts/check_backfill_sample.sh --shard=$SHARD --n=2000`. Will run at canary and post status to this thread.

maria: Posting the soft-commit sample command for runbook:

```bash
# run on canary host
./scripts/check_backfill_sample.sh --shard 2 --n 2000 --expect-missing && echo "canary ok" || echo "canary fail"
```

If failure -> abort.

alex: One more ops control: add emergency rate-cap on the update worker queue: `POST /ops/queue/ratecap {"queue":"backfill", "rps":10}` so we can immediately slow workers without aborting.

ken: Endpoint for replica toggle is up at https://ops.internal/replica-toggle. Token shared in 1:1 with oncall.

deploybot: Canary holdpoint reached at 03:15. Waiting for operator ack to continue flood phase: `/deploy continue 1711359999`.

maria: Ops ack: canary checks green at 03:22. Sample tool returned 0 mismatches on shard 2. Metrics: no p95 regression, errors stable. Proceed to ramp.

jamie: Continuing ramp: increasing concurrency from 3 to 8 over 10 minutes, batch_size stays 4000. Monitoring dashboards pinned.

alex: Monitoring: p95 +2%, error rate +0.4% — within thresholds. Keep watching replication lag.

maria: Backfill progress note: estimated remaining rows 118M, progress ~4% after canary ramp. Runbook updated with kill-switch and progress checkpoint path.

linda: Heads up to support: we'll post release notes after the window with rollback guidance and feature flag timeline.

jamie: If anybody sees a spike, call immediate abort. Otherwise we'll complete by 04:10-04:20 depending on pacing.

maria: Thanks team. I'll collect post-run perf diffs and open a short retro ticket.
